messages:
maria: Heads-up — encountering a regression: users with 'editor' role cannot toggle project-level KMS keys in the Console. Button is hidden and API returns 403 when UI tries to call PUT /projects/:id/keys. @aj @len any idea? :warning:
aj: Can repro locally, thanks for flagging. Will need repro steps and logs.
maria: Repro steps:
1) Login as editor@acme.com
2) Open Project > Settings > Keys
3) Toggle 'Use project KMS'
4) Button disappears and frontend shows 'insufficient permissions'
Server log: `2025-11-05T15:03:21Z ERROR auth: permission denied user=editor@acme action=project:manage_keys project=proj-123`
len: I'm seeing a mismatch — backend permission check is `project:manage_keys` but role matrix recently renamed 'manage_kms' -> 'project:manage_keys' in RBAC refactor. But audit logs show events with no kms_key_id. Query:
``
select id, user, event, payload->>'kms_key_id' as kms_key_id from audit_logs where event = 'kms_key_toggle' order by ts desc limit 25;
```
Many rows have kms_key_id = null which suggests the UI isn't sending key id to be audited.
sarah: If UI stopped sending kms_key_id we should consider two paths: (A) quick UI patch to include id, (B) rollback gating change if it blocks customers. We should canary the rollback to 5% orgs. @security-oncall fyi. :eyes:
devops-bot: deploy triggered: canary/console-ui v2.14.3 -> hosts: ui-canary-1..3 :rocket:
auditsvc: new audit event created id=al_98765 user=editor@acme event=kms_key_toggle ts=1738202000 payload={}
len: Looks like frontend stopped populating payload.kms_key_id after we switched to new permission model. I'll open a tiny PR to re-add payload and also add a defensive check in the backend to fallback to request.body.key_id. Patch:
``
// auth middleware
const keyId = req.body.kms_key_id || req.body.key_id;
audit.log('kms_key_toggle', { user, projectId, kms_key_id: keyId });
```
I'll also add a unit test.
aj: Sounds good. For rollout: merge PR to staging, smoke test audit entries and RBAC check. If we see 0 unexpected 403s, schedule canary release. Ping me when ready. :thumbsup:
maria: Opening incident ticket INC-2025-314, adding timeline and initial impact (some editors couldn't change project KMS, may affect backup rotation). I'll coordinate with support for any customers affected. Thanks everyone.
security-oncall: Thanks — will monitor audit stream and KMS usage for anomalies. Please include the list of orgs in canary so we can focus monitoring.
